project_info.name: Package Compliance Checker
project_info.theme: Light, modern, professional compliance platform (Blue/Indigo primary, neutral surfaces, green/red/amber status indicators)
project_info.disclaimer: Compliance assistance prototype, not an official government portal. Does not make legally binding decisions.

layout_and_navigation.desktop: Fixed left sidebar (64px collapsed / 240px expanded) + Sticky top header with global search, active mode badge, and quick upload CTA
layout_and_navigation.mobile: Top bar with logo and hamburger toggle opening a smooth sheet drawer

pages.name: Login
pages.description: Support Normal User & Authorized Inspector login options

pages.name: Dashboard
pages.description: Key stats, compliance rate chart, recent analyses, rule status summary

pages.name: Upload Package
pages.description: Drag-and-drop image/PDF uploader with live preview & metadata tagging

pages.name: Analysis / Processing
pages.description: Step-by-step progress simulation (OCR extraction -> Legal Metrology Rule matching -> Verification)

pages.name: Compliance Result
pages.description: Full analysis breakdown, compliance score gauge, rule checklist, bounding boxes overlay

pages.name: Violation Details
pages.description: In-depth rule violation breakdown with legal reference clauses & recommended remediation

pages.name: Results History
pages.description: Filterable table of past scans with search, status tabs, and bulk export

pages.name: Reports
pages.description: PDF generation, print layout, compliance summary export, and share controls

pages.name: Settings
pages.description: Rule set config, notification preferences, API key management for mock service

rules: Rule 6(1)(a) - Mandatory Declaration of Manufacturer/Packer Name & Address

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the application using React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS adhering strictly to the SIH26034 problem requirements.
Do NOT add official government seals or claim legally binding output. Include clear disclaimers.
Keep frontend pure presentation; store mock API responses in a dedicated service/localStorage abstraction layer so backend replacement is seamless.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing.
Provide responsive layouts with left sidebar for desktop and slide-out menu for mobile.
Support full demo flow: Signup -> Login -> Dashboard -> Upload -> Processing animation -> Compliance Result -> Violation Detail -> PDF/Print Report.
